newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market rises, refineries in demand.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market rises, refineries in demand.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed firmer on Thursday, with some investors hunting oil refineries and cement makers, traders said.
"Investors ran after refineries and cement producers, due to their relatively low prices," one trader said.
Operators expected the market to remain steady on Friday, with blue chips in focus.
Three independent indices, computed by brokerage houses, based on average prices and market capitalisation, went up from the previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index rose by 5.9 percent to 6,410.4 points, BIG-OTC rose 9.04 percent to 4,667.51 points and CAS-RQ gained 10.23 percent to 1,019 points.
Gainers outnumbered losers by 214 by 126. Prices for 226 stocks remained flat.
Petrobrazi refinery gained 7,000 lei to close at 39,000 under strong buying pressure. Arpechim, another refinery went up 2,000 lei to 40,000, while Petromidia close flat at 42,500.
Cement maker Romcim, long a favourite among investors, ended 16,000 lei higher, but traders said deals concluded throughout the session at around 120,000 lei.
Steel mill Sidex closed 1,500 lei firmer at 24,500.
Turnover rose to 31.9 billion lei from 19.8 billion.
